variables.name: Host

1.content:
# 🛰️ Network Flow Intelligence — OneAgent
Monitoring of network connections detected by **OneAgent** on the `default_network_flows` bucket.
Traffic · Latency (RTT) · TCP Reliability · Services and dependencies · Top talkers

> **How to read this dashboard:** data is measured **from the perspective of the monitored host**. `RX` = bytes *received* by the host · `TX` = bytes *sent* by the host. The `process_is_server` field distinguishes **exposed services** (the host acts as a server) from **outbound dependencies** (the host acts as a client). Use the **Host** selector at the top to narrow the analysis to a specific machine.

10.title: Total flows

11.title: Traffic received (RX)

12.title: Traffic sent (TX)

13.title: New TCP sessions

14.title: Average RTT
14.query:
fetch events, bucket:{"default_network_flows"}
| filter in(host.name, array($Host))
| filter network_flow.tcp.rtt > 0ns
| summarize avg_rtt = avg(network_flow.tcp.rtt)

15.title: Retransmission
15.query:
fetch events, bucket:{"default_network_flows"}
| filter in(host.name, array($Host))
| summarize retrans = sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.rx) + sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.tx), base = sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.base.rx) + sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.base.tx)
| fieldsAdd retrans_pct = if(base > 0, (toDouble(retrans) / base) * 100, else: 0.0)
| fields retrans_pct

20.content:
## 📊 Traffic volume
Evolution of bandwidth (RX/TX) and rate of new TCP sessions. Used to detect **traffic spikes**, **consumption trends**, and the main network **top talkers**. Useful for sizing links and locating anomalous transfers.

30.content:
## 🧩 Services and dependencies
**Exposed services** (`process_is_server = true`): ports on which monitored hosts **listen** and accept inbound connections.
**Outbound dependencies** (`process_is_server = false`): external services that hosts **connect to** as a client.

Well-known ports are automatically translated to service names: `1521 → Oracle DB` · `445 → SMB` · `1414/1415 → IBM MQ` · `102 → Siemens S7` · `8222 → NATS` · `10050/10051 → Zabbix` · `389 → LDAP` · `443 → HTTPS` · `3690 → SVN`. The table below shows the **dependency map** host → destination with traffic, latency, and retransmission.

31.title: Exposed services (inbound) — by new sessions
31.query:
fetch events, bucket:{"default_network_flows"}
| filter in(host.name, array($Host))
| filter network_flow.process_is_server == true
| summarize new_sessions = sum(network_flow.tcp.sessions.new), bytes = sum(network_flow.bytes.rx) + sum(network_flow.bytes.tx), clients = countDistinct(network_flow.source.address), by: {network_flow.destination.port}
| fieldsAdd service = coalesce(if(network_flow.destination.port == 22, "SSH"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 102, "Siemens S7"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 135, "MS-RPC"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 389, "LDAP"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 443, "HTTPS"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 445, "SMB"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 1414, "IBM MQ"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 1415, "IBM MQ"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 1521, "Oracle DB"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 3690, "SVN"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 8080, "HTTP-Alt"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 8222, "NATS"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 10050, "Zabbix Agent"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 10051, "Zabbix Server"), toString(network_flow.destination.port))
| fieldsAdd label = concat(service, " (", toString(network_flow.destination.port), ")")
| sort new_sessions desc
| limit 12

32.title: Outbound dependencies (consumed) — by traffic
32.query:
fetch events, bucket:{"default_network_flows"}
| filter in(host.name, array($Host))
| filter network_flow.process_is_server == false
| summarize bytes = sum(network_flow.bytes.rx) + sum(network_flow.bytes.tx), peers = countDistinct(network_flow.destination.address), by: {network_flow.destination.port}
| fieldsAdd service = coalesce(if(network_flow.destination.port == 22, "SSH"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 102, "Siemens S7"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 135, "MS-RPC"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 389, "LDAP"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 443, "HTTPS"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 445, "SMB"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 1414, "IBM MQ"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 1415, "IBM MQ"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 1521, "Oracle DB"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 3690, "SVN"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 8080, "HTTP-Alt"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 8222, "NATS"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 10050, "Zabbix Agent"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 10051, "Zabbix Server"), toString(network_flow.destination.port))
| fieldsAdd label = concat(service, " (", toString(network_flow.destination.port), ")")
| sort bytes desc
| limit 12

33.title: Dependency map — Host → Destination service
33.query:
fetch events, bucket:{"default_network_flows"}
| filter in(host.name, array($Host))
| filter network_flow.process_is_server == false
| summarize bytes = sum(network_flow.bytes.rx) + sum(network_flow.bytes.tx), flows = count(), avg_rtt = avg(network_flow.tcp.rtt), retrans = sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.rx) + sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.tx), base = sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.base.rx) + sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.base.tx), by: {host.name, network_flow.destination.address, network_flow.destination.port}
| fieldsAdd service = coalesce(if(network_flow.destination.port == 22, "SSH"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 102, "Siemens S7"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 135, "MS-RPC"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 389, "LDAP"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 443, "HTTPS"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 445, "SMB"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 1414, "IBM MQ"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 1415, "IBM MQ"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 1521, "Oracle DB"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 3690, "SVN"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 8080, "HTTP-Alt"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 8222, "NATS"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 10050, "Zabbix Agent"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 10051, "Zabbix Server"), toString(network_flow.destination.port))
| fieldsAdd retrans_pct = if(base > 0, (toDouble(retrans) / base) * 100, else: 0.0)
| fieldsRemove retrans, base
| sort bytes desc
| limit 25

40.content:
## ⏱️ Network latency (RTT)
**RTT (Round-Trip Time)** measures the round-trip time of TCP packets between the host and its peer. Stored in **nanoseconds** and displayed already formatted (µs/ms). **High or increasing** values indicate congestion, suboptimal routes, destination saturation, or physical link issues.

> Samples with `RTT = 0` (flows with no measurement available) are excluded so as not to dilute the averages.

41.title: TCP latency over time (average RTT and p95)
41.query:
fetch events, bucket:{"default_network_flows"}
| filter in(host.name, array($Host))
| filter network_flow.tcp.rtt > 0ns
| makeTimeseries avg_rtt = avg(network_flow.tcp.rtt), p95_rtt = percentile(network_flow.tcp.rtt, 95), interval: 5m

42.title: Pairs with highest latency (average RTT)
42.query:
fetch events, bucket:{"default_network_flows"}
| filter in(host.name, array($Host))
| filter network_flow.tcp.rtt > 0ns
| summarize avg_rtt = avg(network_flow.tcp.rtt), max_rtt = max(network_flow.tcp.rtt), flows = count(), by: {host.name, network_flow.destination.address, network_flow.destination.port}
| fieldsAdd service = coalesce(if(network_flow.destination.port == 22, "SSH"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 102, "Siemens S7"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 389, "LDAP"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 443, "HTTPS"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 445, "SMB"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 1414, "IBM MQ"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 1521, "Oracle DB"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 8080, "HTTP-Alt"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 8222, "NATS"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 10050, "Zabbix Agent"), if(network_flow.destination.port == 10051, "Zabbix Server"), toString(network_flow.destination.port))
| sort avg_rtt desc
| limit 20

50.content:
## 🛡️ TCP reliability and quality
**Retransmissions**: packets resent due to loss or expiry, expressed as **% over the base** of packets (`packets.retransmitted.base`). `< 1%` is healthy · `1–3%` needs monitoring · `> 3%` indicates a problem (packet loss, saturation, or firewall).
**Resets / Timeouts**: connections closed abruptly (RST) or expired. `0` = no issues.

These metrics are the **best early indicator** of network problems for the networking team.

51.title: Retransmission rate over time (% over base)
51.query:
fetch events, bucket:{"default_network_flows"}
| filter in(host.name, array($Host))
| makeTimeseries retrans_rx = sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.rx), retrans_tx = sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.tx), base_rx = sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.base.rx), base_tx = sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.base.tx), interval: 5m
| fieldsAdd retrans_pct = ((retrans_rx[] + retrans_tx[]) / (base_rx[] + base_tx[])) * 100
| fields timeframe, interval, retrans_pct

52.title: TCP connection errors

53.title: Retransmitted packets

54.title: Pairs with worst quality — Retransmission + RTT
54.query:
fetch events, bucket:{"default_network_flows"}
| filter in(host.name, array($Host))
| summarize retrans = sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.rx) + sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.tx), base = sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.base.rx) + sum(network_flow.packets.retransmitted.base.tx), bytes = sum(network_flow.bytes.rx) + sum(network_flow.bytes.tx), avg_rtt = avg(network_flow.tcp.rtt), by: {host.name, network_flow.source.address, network_flow.destination.address, network_flow.destination.port}
| filter base > 500
| fieldsAdd retrans_pct = (toDouble(retrans) / base) * 100
| fieldsRemove retrans
| sort retrans_pct desc
| limit 20
